about: The heading of a Gospel reading from Saint Luke. Sequéntia means the continuation: the passage is read from the course of the Gospel, not from its opening verses. The 1962 Roman Missal prints it over the Gospels of the First Sunday of Advent, of the Masses of Christmas during the night and at dawn and of the Annunciation of the Blessed Virgin Mary, among many other Masses.

s01.translation: The continuation of the holy Gospel according to Luke
